noticias.titulo: Wall Street pitches data centers as real estate bet. Risks are rising
noticias.resumo: For the most part, the funds from alternative investment companies promising investors a piece of the physical infrastructure powering the AI economy remain the province of institutional investors like pension funds.  But the trend has to a limited degree also dipped into the retail investor market.  Alternative investments giant Blackstone has been at the forefront, creating the Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust, a newly formed real estate investment trust, or REIT, that trades on the NYSE, earlier this year.
